Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OF THE FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT s. 2010 DIL OPI N MR- C. CHOA National President Subdivision and Housing Developers Association, Inc. 5/ F Kalayaan Building corner Dela Rosa and Salcedo Sts. Legaspi Village, Makati City Dear Mr. Choa: This pertains to your letter-query seeking this Department's opinion on the propriety of the ordinances/resolutions issued by a number of Local Government Units (LGUs) limiting the manner of compliance with the 20% socialized housing requirement to projects located within the LGU. You mentioned also that such ordinances/resolutions contravene national laws. In reply thereto, since the subject Ordinances/Resolutions had already been approved by the concerned sanggunians, we are of the view that they should be accorded the presumption of validity unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issues or questions thereon relative to their non- compliance with the substantive requirements in the passage of such ordinances/resolutions should already be threshed out by filing a special civil action for Declaratory Relief before the proper court in accordance with Section 1, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provides and we quote: "Section I. Who may file Petition- Any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statute, executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional Trial Court to determine any question of construction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder. " Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretwy Legal Service:LD/28/eIIen
